text:
Nadia Ortiz: Quick design QA: noticed the action buttons in the resource table feel taller than in the compact modal footer. also toasts slide in and briefly cover the row actions on small screens. anyone else hit this?

Jin Park: yep saw that on mobile width during QA. I think the table buttons use `btn-compact` token but modal uses `btn-default`.

Eleni: token drift again. We updated button radius and vertical padding last month but didnt propagate to table action styles.

Mark: repro steps: Console > Resources > select row > open actions menu. Toggle a toast by saving something. On 360px width the toast overlaps the menu.

Nadia Ortiz: attaching quick screenshot in thread (inline). feels like visual weight mismatch + focus ring colors differ when keyboarding.

Jin Park: shared snippet from storybook: ```css
.btn { --btn-vert: var(--rwd-space-2); border-radius: var(--rwd-radius-2); }
.table .row-action .btn { --btn-vert: var(--rwd-space-1); }
.modal .footer .btn { --btn-vert: var(--rwd-space-2); }
.toast { transform: translateY(0); bottom: 16px; left: 16px; }
```

Eleni: proposal: 1) align tokens so row-action uses `--rwd-button-vertical` (avoid space-1). 2) add `--rwd-toast-safety` token used by table to add bottom padding when toast present. 3) unify focus ring color to `--rwd-focus-strong` across components.

Mark: for copy, table action text is full verb "Apply changes" vs modal uses "Save". prefer short in table; can we make guidance in component docs?

Nadia Ortiz: agreed — short labels for inline actions, full labels for modals. I'll add a line in Buttons docs.

DesignBot: Visual test job queued for branch snack/button-token-sync (#4337) 1:04:12.

Jin Park: small a11y note: if we increase vertical padding we must ensure contrast and focus size still meet 4.5:1 and hit target >= 44x44. adding to checklist.

Eleni: I'll update tokens file and add a migration note. Also adding a small story that shows table+modal+toast together so visual-regression catches it.

Nadia Ortiz: assigning PR to @Eleni for token changes and @Jin for a11y checklist. leaving copy note to docs.

Mark: tiny nit — toast entrance animation is 240ms ease-out whereas most overlays are 200ms. can we standardize to 200ms? less jank.

Eleni: happy to change to 200ms.

DesignBot: Branch merged to staging. Changed stories: buttons/compact, table/row-actions, toasts/placement. CI: visual-regression passed, a11y-lint flagged 1 minor (focus color contrast) — assigned to Jin.
